description: Propose a better fact for a dataset, propose reverting a document to an earlier version, or propose deleting a document. The change stays pending until a dataset owner approves it.

action.description: Defaults to add_document. delete_document needs only dataset and document_id.

document_id.description: Set to replace or delete an existing document

restore_version.description: With replace_document and document_id, propose reverting the document to this stored version; title/text are taken from the version history.

text.description: The improved document text; required unless action is delete_document

name: koskamo_propose_revision
title: Propose a revision
